title: Fourth Fourier moment and convolution
statement: For any function $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, the sum of the fourth powers of its vector Fourier coefficients equals $\mathbb{E}_t[(f*f)(t)^2]$, where $t$ is uniform on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and $f*f$ denotes the normalized convolution of $f$ with itself.
